ios.name: Dripn: AI Outfit Stylist
ios.subtitle: AI outfit suggestions
ios.subtitleNotes: Apple-safe: no overclaims. Stay under 30 chars.
ios.promotionalText: Build a digital wardrobe and get AI-powered outfit suggestions for everyday life.
ios.description:
Dripn helps you decide what to wear with AI-powered style suggestions.

Upload clothes to a digital wardrobe, chat with AI stylists, and get outfit ideas for everyday occasions — from work to weekends.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Add clothing from photos to your wardrobe
• Chat with AI stylists for outfit suggestions
• Explore colour and style insights
• Get ideas for different occasions
• Optional voice replies for hands-free styling chats

HOW IT WORKS

1. Set up your style preferences
2. Add items from your closet
3. Ask for outfit ideas in chat
4. Try looks and refine what you like

SUBSCRIPTIONS

Dripn offers free access with optional paid plans for more styling capacity and features. Subscriptions and in-app purchases on iOS are handled through the Apple App Store.

Privacy Policy: https://dripnapp.com/privacy
Terms of Service: https://dripnapp.com/terms

Style suggestions are for inspiration — you choose what to wear.

designRules: Show real app UI — not mockups only
Promise clarity, avoid guaranteed results language
Exact pixel dimensions — no upscaled blur

reviewNotes.socialLogin: Hidden for this build. Social login (Apple/Google/Facebook) is not required for review — use the demo account.

notes: Avoid words like perfect, instantly, guaranteed, better than humans.
Do not claim result counts you cannot verify.
iOS subscriptions must use Apple IAP in production builds.
Screenshot text goes ON the image frames — not into App Store Connect text fields.
